item.name: Food_Probe_Thermometer
item.description: ThermoWorks ThermoPop 2 NSF-certified instant-read thermometer with probe cover.
item.readyBeforeUse: The probe is clean, sanitized, dry, and the display turns on.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, the probe is cleaned and sanitized after each reading. After service, it is clean, sanitized, dry, covered, and stored.
item.ifNotReady: Do not estimate a food temperature. Ask the Food Lead for a working sanitized thermometer.
